evidence.conflictsToKeep: No official Antigravity Usage popover showing Gemini weekly 0% was visually confirmed in this pass (the 2% claim is on a video post; frames were not extracted). The 0% widget is Claude & GPT. DeepSleepSun (2121405591151321519) orally said they ran about 3亿 Carbon in two days and still had 50%+ weekly left, and suspected this panel missed subagent tokens — keep that conflict, do not splice accounts. Cache is 272M of 306M. API value ≠ subscription quota. Period starts 11-06 16:00, after the already-known Nov 6 official reset. KOF97AI and Betaer are echoes, not independent tests.
